title: Source unit
description: One source unit of an ontology dataset (contract 'ontology' 0.1.0). Corpus units are the items of 00_sources/<NN>_<slug>/units/<doc-id>.yaml (a YAML list, in document order); a user statement is one file 00_sources/90_user_statements/<su-id>.yaml. Readers must ignore properties they do not know.

id.description: Minted, opaque, stable ID: 'su_' + ULID. Never derived from the text or the position, never reused.

document_id.description: ID of the document the unit belongs to: 'doc_' + ULID. Absent for user statements.

location.description: Where the unit is in its document. Absent for user statements.

path.description: Path of the Markdown file, relative to the corpus source folder.

heading_path.description: The headings above the unit, outermost first. Empty when the document has no headings.

index_in_section.description: 0-based position of the unit among the units of its section.

content_hash.description: 'sha256:' + hex SHA-256 of the text after Unicode NFC and whitespace normalisation (runs of whitespace become one space; leading and trailing whitespace removed). Two units with the same text share a hash and keep separate IDs.

text.description: The normalised text of the unit (for a user statement: of its latest revision).

ignorable.description: Present when the unit was proposed as ignorable. Nothing is extracted from a unit whose verdict is proposed or confirmed.

status.description: proposed by the LLM; confirmed by a person; rejected = a person marked it not ignorable.

author.description: User handle of a user statement.

revisions.description: Every revision of a user statement, oldest first. The ID never changes.
